title: review — yearly archive storage and selected restore

text: Review findings to fix before merge: ID scanning omitted the value quote; incomplete epics could lose old completed members; stats default did not read archived history; TUI reload/project paths discarded archive; archive reads and writes bypassed held path checks; stale mv could restore an untouched archived row; restoration cleanup ran outside the write lock; init and notice wording were incomplete. Existing green tests did not cover the new command or these failure paths.

Grade: max — whole-epic manual review of storage transactions, write scaling, concurrent mutations, archive/history surfaces, initialization and generated documentation, including develop conflict resolution.

1. src/archive.rs::id_counts: the canonical ID prefix initially omitted the value quote, allowing archived IDs to escape reservation. Fixed the prefix and retained the existing ID reader for hand-written and unreadable rows. Repository-write reservation regression passes.
2. src/archive.rs::eligible: moving an old closed member out of an unfinished epic or parent/review bundle changes active group results. Fixed selection to require the entire connected component to be old and closed; milestones remain live. Recent, incomplete and duplicate bundles are covered.
3. src/cmd/mv.rs and src/store.rs: stale/no-op requests initially restored rows and cleanup ran outside the write lock. Only successfully reopened selections now enter the live snapshot; cleanup runs after the live commit while the same lock remains held. Stale/no-op, selected child and epic reopening, and concurrent archive/restore regressions pass.
4. src/archive.rs::append/remove_ids: file writes initially bypassed repository path validation and atomic replacement. Added held-path checks, regular-file reads, preflight of all destinations and synced atomic replacements. Unknown and malformed neighboring lines survive cleanup verbatim. Outside symlinks and FIFOs are rejected. Interrupted append retries accept identical copies; conflicting changed live rows are retained and reported.
5. src/cmd/stats.rs and src/cmd/show.rs: default statistics and historical date/filter queries lost physically moved rows. Statistics now always read history; targeted, archived, search and historical filter queries merge archive data with the active worktree overlay. CLI regressions cover these surfaces.
6. src/cmd/tui.rs and src/tui/mod.rs::prepare: reload/project-entry paths initially lost archives and background archive changes were not watched. All startup, reload and entry paths retain the overlay and merge archive data with archive file/directory marks. Existing startup/reload parity and the new background-change regression pass.
7. src/cmd/init.rs, src/cmd/status.rs and src/view.rs: initialization and relocated storage need archive merge attributes, and pending archive rows need a meaningful notice. Added both, alongside cross-file duplicate detection and English/Korean notice text. Yearly file merge-driver and initialization checks pass.
8. CHANGELOG.md: resolving the develop merge with the archive-side file removed neighboring init/backlog release entries. Restored the complete develop changelog and inserted only the archive and write-index entries. The final diff has no removed release notes.
9. tests/cli.rs: the comments-only initialization fixture lacked the newly required archive rule, so it correctly changed real rules and failed its comments-only assertion. Updated the fixture to contain all current rules, preserving its original assertion. Added archive to the complete JSON command sweep.

Five required review checks:
- Documentation attachment: new functions have their own comments; existing Repo::read/write documentation still describes its original item.
- Revert sensitivity: storage, stale guard, ID reservation, concurrent restore, file validation, history query and reload tests assert externally observable outcomes and fail when their corresponding fixes are removed. The write-index compatibility test preserves first-twin comparison; the separately recorded 8x benchmark measures scaling rather than claiming a timing unit test.
- Setup paths: CLI explorer startup, reload and multi-project prepare paths all merge archive rows and watch their stamps; init mirrors archive attributes for relocated .moai.
- Documentation fidelity: guide, generated AGENTS and command references, CLI help, wiki and release procedure describe explicit yearly archives, complete closed bundles, live milestones and selected-row-only restoration. Checked-in generation checks pass; wiki reports no broken links or anchors.
- Newly opened paths: archive reads and ID scans use held regular-file validation; mutations preflight destination paths and use existing atomic storage writes. Normal live moves avoid full archive Issue parsing; hot boards remain active-snapshot based with lightweight archive ID scanning where required.

Residual transaction property: archive and active files are not one filesystem transaction. A process failure between replacements can leave duplicate copies, but destination-first archival and live-first restoration preserve the row. Identical archive retries recover the former case; status identifies duplicate IDs and conflicting newer live data is never discarded. This matches the JSONL storage approach without introducing a new database or journal format.

No findings remain handed on and no background review tasks remain.

Decision: accepted and fixed findings 1–9 in this epic. No findings handed on; no parked backlog or unfinished parallel-file members remain. Final validation covers the unit and full CLI suites, clippy, generated documents and wiki links.

Both leads were real bugs from this epic, so both tests stay:
- (a) `show.rs` began reading the archive on every call, but hiding archived rows only looked at the clock — the same thing put archived epics back on the `status` board when `archive_days = 0`.

Findings:
1. src/store.rs:1159 — Every unreadable archive line, and every failed restore cleanup, was reported through the lost-history channel, and every write fully parsed the archive while holding the lock. With conflict markers in .moai/archive/2025.jsonl each add, note or no-op mv printed one "written, but the history could not be kept … do not call it again" line per bad line though the journal was written; the explorer showed only the first, hiding a real journal loss. With a 20k-row archive, 7 of 12 concurrent `moai note` runs failed with "another moai has been writing for 5 seconds" (base: 0).
2. src/archive.rs:301 — `archive --drop` deleted every archive line with the id without checking it was a copy of the live row, ran before the snapshot checks, and reported success when nothing was removed. A live "new issue" and archived "old issue" sharing an id: `--drop` erased the old issue for good. With an unrelated live duplicate it deleted the archive copy then exited 1. On an id with no archive copy it printed "removed archive copies".
3. src/archive.rs:319 — Restore cleanup and `--drop` stopped on any unreadable archive file, even an unrelated one. A FIFO or non-UTF-8 2024.jsonl with the row in 2026.jsonl: the restore left a fatal `archive_duplicate_id`, and the suggested `--drop` exited 1 until the unrelated file was fixed by hand.
4. src/report.rs:5884 — The warning post-filter removed ids that are not readable live rows, and ran after the deadline insertion point was recorded. Two unreadable lines with the same id gave only `unreadable_line` (lead b); an archived row with an unknown field pushed `milestone_overdue` below the fatal `unreadable_line`.
5. src/query.rs:288 — Hiding archived rows depended only on the clock, but `show` and `status` now read archived rows on every call. With `archive_days = 0`, or a raised value, archived rows came back in `show --all` and archived epics on the status board (lead a).
6. src/cmd/status.rs:326 — The multi-project `status` and `ready` overviews still read only live rows: a shipped milestone showed as an empty overdue todo, archived blockers raised `dangling_blocked_by`, overview `ready` offered work in-repo `ready` holds back.
7. src/cmd/hook.rs:1657 — The hook board, Stop check and baseline left out `archive_duplicate_id` and `archive_pending`: status exited 1 with a fatal collision while the session board said "nothing showing", and Stop never held a session that left a collision behind.
8. src/archive.rs:166 — A restore ignored an unreadable live line with the same id: `mv X todo --from done` wrote the stale archive copy next to it (fatal `duplicate_id`) and deleted the archive copy.
9. src/cmd/archive.rs:32 — `--dry-run` and the `archive_pending` notice ignored conflicts the real run skips, and eligibility read group columns from live rows only. The dry run listed a bundle the real run kept live ("archived 0 rows") and the notice never cleared; an epic restored alone was counted archived by the board but could never be archived again.
10. src/archive.rs:181 — Taking over an archived row without moving it was thrown away: `mv <archived> done --take` journaled "Taken-over: B" and reported `taken`, but the row stayed archived with B as assignee.
11. src/cmd/mv.rs:166 — `mv` read the archive only when the moved row's own ancestors needed it and computed newly freed work from live rows only: closing a loose blocker listed the restored member under `unblocked` with no `derived_epic`, and "↳ next" offered work `ready` holds back.
12. src/archive.rs:322 — The cleanup and `--drop` line matchers did not skip a byte-order mark, which the reader does: the restore kept the copy (fatal duplicate) and `--drop` reported success without removing it.
13. src/archive.rs:96 — `marks()` still failed when the archive directory could not be listed: with `.moai/archive` a regular file or an outside link, `moai tui` and `tui --json` exited 1 while status, show and writes worked.

Survey: removing mail and presence (Fable, read-only, 2026-10-06, at develop 08fc789a). Line numbers are as of that commit.

# 1. Inventory

Rust core (~5,200 lines, removable as a block)
- Mailbox + presence module: `src/mail.rs` (2,915; tests from 1927, 34 unit tests). Letters 128-818, presence 819-1339, process/anchors 1340-1625, wake 1626-1727, fencing 1728-1926
- Commands: `src/cmd/mail.rs` (489, send/inbox), `src/cmd/agents.rs` (442, agents/hello), `src/view/mail.rs` (257)
- CLI: `src/cli.rs` Send/Inbox/Agents/Hello 450-631, arg structs 1172-1262
- Dispatch/mod decls: `src/cmd/mod.rs:7,15,559-562`, `src/main.rs:22`, `src/view.rs:16`
- Hooks: `src/cmd/hook.rs` `decide()`: StopFailure/Interrupt/SessionEnd 190-194 (only `rest()` → idle), compact 257-270, SessionStart 277, UserPromptSubmit 318-340 (busy + `hook.you_are` + load letters), PreToolUse 344-351 (`keep_alive`), Stop 497-548 (letters hold the turn, session file `letters`). Helpers `attendee/rest/attend/Mine/waiting/deliver` 1250-1507; tests 1751-1806. `src/hook.rs`: `letter_block/block_to` 293-307, `deliverable/letters/cut_to` 444-550, `Carry::letters_room` + `LETTERS_MIN/FRAME` ~395, `guard_subagent_mail` 6685-6700 (called cmd/hook.rs:147 only when `Input.agent_id` 122 is set), tests ~15170-15270. **Keep** `Carry/Room/Unit/CONTEXT_CAP/CODEX_HOLD` 218-431 (used by `closing_hold`, `answer`, `skill::codex_hooks`)
- Hook events that exist only for presence: `src/skill.rs` `HOOKS` 118-127 StopFailure, SessionEnd; `CODEX` 141-162 Interrupt, SessionEnd (tests skill.rs:2249, `CODEX_TIMEOUT_CAP` 2304). Antigravity: none
- Config: repo key `mail_read_days` — `src/config.rs` 348-373, 424-434, 515, test 752-765. No user-config key
- Storage paths: `src/store.rs` `mail_at/agents_at` 223-232, `Repo::mail_dir/agents_dir` 630-638
- i18n: `i18n/en.json` + `ko.json` 1096-1137, 44 keys (`mail.*` 15, `agents.*` 6, `refuse.mail_*` 7, `refuse.agents_*` 8, `warn.mail_garbled`, `warn.agents_garbled`, `hook.you_are/letters/letters_left/letter_cut`). ja/zh/es: 0. The parity tests (`src/i18n.rs:332, 464`) do not catch unused keys
- .gitignore / init: `.gitignore:6-7`; `src/cmd/init.rs` template 1192-1204, missing-line tolerance 880-887, tests 2348-2362, 2402-2418
- TUI/status/query/store writes: nothing (grep hits are comments; report/stats `mail` is an e-mail variable)

Guide and skill text (`src/guide.rs`, ~1,400 lines)
- `SUBAGENT_MAIL` 38-57; `MAILBOX` 867-889 ("Letters between agents" body); VERBS row "Wake a session that sits idle" 989-992 (reaches all three skills via `verbs_section()` 999); `agents()` 1220-1228 ("The supervisor and its workers") and 1230-1232 ("Letters between agents")
- `supervise()` 1789-2681 (~890): intro 1801-1812, "Say hello first" 1818-1829, step 0 reads `moai agents` 1866-1869/1898-1906 + stalled-work letter 1909-1916, step 2 `moai agents --json --role worker --status idle` 1968-2004, step 3 `moai send` + slots 2045-2099, step 4 `moai inbox --ack --wait 540` 2101-2121, step 5 2154-2169, **5-1 tmux clear 2171-2651 (~480; python reads `moai agents --json` 2244, sends a letter 2512-2523, types `moai inbox` 2534)**. Keep: base-branch block 1830-1850, 2-1 model choice 2024-2043, "The shared root" 2652, "When to stop" 2664
- `letter()` 2711-2725, `work()` (moai-work) 2739-2904, `brief()` 2905-3222 (~320 — the worker's 12 steps; used only by `work()` and tests; **orphaned when moai-work goes** — the steps a worker must follow have to land in what the supervisor sends)
- Planting: `src/skill.rs` `NAMES` 36, `skills()` 54-73 (moai-work at 71). Checked-in copies: `.claude/moai-plugin/skills/{moai-supervise,moai-work}/SKILL.md` (913/517), identical `.agents/skills/*`; `.codex/hooks.json`, `.agents/hooks.json`, `plugin.json` carry the presence-only events. `the_checked_in_plugin_matches_the_guide` (skill.rs:2850) regenerates with `MOAI_BLESS=1 cargo test checked_in`; it does not flag extra directories. `AGENTS.md` block 515-535 → `moai init`. `CLAUDE.md:445-446` cites moai-work "When the person is away"

Tests
- `tests/cli.rs` (792 tests): **60 dedicated** in 24224-27268 (sections at 24224, 25611, 26233 minus 8 dialect tests): send/inbox 21, hello/agents/anchors 18, Claude hooks 13, Codex/Antigravity hooks 10. Shared, keep: `Sleeper` 24229, `json_text`, `held_reason`, `recorded`, `dialect_out`
- Sweeps: `the_json_sweep_covers_every_command` 7388-7412 → `JSON_SWEEP` 7480-7485 (`hello/send/inbox/agents`); `every_command_still_speaks_json` 7884-7970 → 7893-7896. `skill_uninstall_names_the_shared_skills_and_deletes_nothing` 18651 lists moai-work. `the_cli_reference_matches_the_help` 21850 → regenerate `docs/cli.md`
- `src/guide.rs` tests: `the_supervisor_and_the_workers_say_hello_and_trade_letters` 5241-5298 (**asserts supervise does NOT contain "with `SendMessage`" — must flip**), 5201, 4858, 4902; 5-1/tmux 4392, 4427, 4532, 4593, 4660; ~25 tests call `work()/brief()/letter()` (3250-5181 incl. `the_rubric_is_the_review_table` 3973, `the_supervisor_picks_a_model_by_difficulty` 3898). skill.rs 1209 (placeholders 1366-1374), 1444, 1459, 1483

Docs: `docs/agents.md` 135-255 (per-vendor setup, mail-heavy), 256-297 hook table, 333-434 "Leave each other letters", 435-490, 491-514, 515-638 (~20 mail bullets); `docs/glossary.md` Brief 29-33, Letter 108-120, Presence 173-185, Supervisor 214-221, Worker 244-250; `README.md` 243-274; `docs/cli.md` generated. CHANGELOG 0.7.0 bullets 181-335 are history — leave them

Storage: `<root>/.moai/mail/<name>/{,read/}`, `.moai/agents/<name>.json`, each with its own `.gitignore`; nothing in the user config dir; `issues.jsonl` and the journal are untouched (test 24291 asserts status/ready/show bytes identical)

# 2. Coupling
Nothing kept depends on it. Hook rules 1-5 have no mail reference. `stranded` is built from worktrees + issues only (`worktree::stranded_at` 1347 → `report::stranded_in` 1758); presence feeds it nowhere — the supervisor's step 0 reads `moai agents` in prose to tell a busy session apart, replaceable by `ListAgents`. `ready --worktree`, `prime`, status notices, the explorer, `held.rs` (general fencing), `latest`, `wiki`: no dependency. After removal StopFailure/Interrupt/SessionEnd become no-ops; `Input.agent_id` and the subagent guard are dead; `closing_hold` is unaffected

# 3. Native same-vendor messaging
- Claude Code — sure: `ListAgents` lists live sessions (this machine, other machines, cloud) with `name [ref]` and busy/idle; `SendMessage(to: <bare name>)`; `notify_when_idle: true` gives one idle notice (replaces `inbox --wait` and presence); replies arrive as cross-session messages (reply by copying `from`). Caveats: a session in another permission mode holds messages for its user's approval; subagents send under the parent's address; `@path` attaches nothing
- Codex, Antigravity — no native means known. Person's decision: no supervisor skill there

# 4. Compatibility
- Old planted hooks call `moai hook stop-failure|interrupt|session-end`: if removed outright the wrapper prints "the X hook could not run (exit 2)" once per session → keep the three as silent no-ops for one release; `skill install` (already rewrites `plugin.json`, `.codex/hooks.json`, `.agents/hooks.json`) drops the events
- Old `moai-work`/`moai-supervise` trees tell agents to run `moai hello/inbox/send` → exit 2. `skill install` removes `skills/moai-work/` in all three trees and `skills/moai-supervise/` in the Codex and Antigravity trees (precedent `cmd/skill.rs retire()` 1236-1242/1464, `drop_marketplace` skill.rs:988)
- `.moai/mail`, `.moai/agents` on disk: gitignored, inert — leave alone (person's decision); `moai init` stops writing and checking the two ignore lines (init.rs 880-887, 1192-1204); existing lines stay
- `mail_read_days` in config.toml: silently ignored after removal (config.rs tolerates unknown flat keys except `status_*`) — say so in CHANGELOG
- Regenerate: planted trees `MOAI_BLESS=1 cargo test checked_in`; `AGENTS.md` via `moai init`; `docs/cli.md` via `scripts/gen-cli-docs.sh`
- CHANGELOG `### Removed` + `### Changed` → minor → 0.9.0

Backlog to park once this lands: remove the silent `stop-failure`/`interrupt`/`session-end` hook subcommands in the release after.

/code-review xhigh --fix — reviewer's report (2026-10-07)

No correctness bugs in the removal. All tests pass (1930 unit, 748 integration, one new), no build warnings, fmt clean. Three small fixes applied.

Checked and sound:
- The hook input struct ignores unknown fields, so dropping `model` and `agent_id` doesn't break parsing of Claude's or Codex's payloads.
- Stop, UserPromptSubmit, compact SessionStart and PreToolUse simplify cleanly; the "stop at the second Stop" loop guard is intact.
- `.codex/hooks.json` loses only its two handlers; the remaining ones are byte-identical, so Codex's per-handler trust holds.
- `mail_read_days` in an old config.toml is ignored without error.
- Every one of the 59 deleted integration tests covered mail or presence. Rules still covered elsewhere (broken root config, archive symlink containment) keep their own tests.

Findings:
1. tests/cli.rs:24423 — Nothing tested the CHANGELOG promise that stop-failure, interrupt and session-end are silent no-ops inside a repository; Codex recordings interrupt.json, session-end.json, session-start.json were left unused. Failure: the existing test feeds these events only outside a repository, so a regression that reads or writes per-session state on them inside one would pass.
2. src/cmd/hook.rs:102 — The early return in `run` duplicated the Pass `decide` already returns for the same three events, leaving decide's Interrupt/SessionEnd arms reachable only via the Antigravity StopFailure translation. Failure: one decision in two places; next release's cleanup must remove both, and doc pointers named `run`.
3. src/skill.rs:148 — Comments still described letters as current behaviour and cited the removed `hook::letters_room`; same at 193 and 2473.
4. src/cmd/init.rs:881 — Comments at 881 and 1194 cite the removed `mail::ensure_dir`; init still writes the `.moai/mail/` and `.moai/agents/` ignore lines (moai-six5.p9p's job).
5. src/guide.rs:857 — The guide, planted moai-supervise/moai-work skills and the AGENTS.md block still teach `moai send/inbox/hello/agents`, which now exit 2. Failure: if this branch reaches a release without moai-obxm, agents hit unknown-command errors.
6. CHANGELOG.md:15 — Under [Unreleased], `### Removed` comes before `### Changed`; older releases (0.7.0, 0.4.0) put Changed first.

text:
Review text — /code-review high --fix on worktree-moai-r0x8 (merge-base develop..HEAD, 7 commits). The reviewer's own words.

I found 9 problems on the `moai-r0x8` branch. I fixed 5 of them in the working tree, so they are uncommitted. The full suite passes (1939 unit and 760 CLI tests). Before fixing, I reproduced the two worst ones (#1 and #2) with the dev binary.

1. src/store.rs:2507 — into_tracker decides 'inside the tracker' only by a `.moai` component in the resolved path, so a `.moai` that is itself a directory link inside the checkout (or `.moai/journal` / `.moai/archive` linked elsewhere in the checkout) is not protected.
   Failure: Reproduced: `mv .moai data && ln -s data .moai && ln -s .moai/config.toml AGENTS.md` (or `-> data/config.toml`), then `moai init` exits 0 and writes the AGENTS block into config.toml. The next `moai status` dies with `line 7: not a key = "value" line`. This is the exact a42 failure class the commit claims to close.
2. src/store.rs:698 — Repo::open refuses a non-directory `.moai` before trying the worktree redirect, while find_from (via from_found) redirects first. The same directory gets two answers.
   Failure: Reproduced: in a linked worktree whose `.moai` is a regular file and whose main checkout holds a tracker, `moai status` exits 0 and reads the main tracker. `moai project add/ls` for that same directory reports `state: unreadable`, `code: broken`. The tui layer, which also uses Repo::open, would show the same error.
3. src/store.rs:2516 — into_tracker checks only the root tracker's linked snapshot. A nested sub-tracker whose snapshot is a link (`sub/.moai/issues.jsonl -> ../data/issues.jsonl`) is not covered, although on_lock explicitly handles nested trackers' locks.
   Failure: A committed `AGENTS.md -> sub/data/issues.jsonl` passes resolve, on_lock and into_tracker. `moai init` at the root then rewrites the sub-tracker's snapshot without that tracker's lock, and rows added concurrently in `sub` are lost.
4. src/cmd/init.rs:389 — `bare` is taken from `main_root(root).is_none()`, which is not the same thing as 'bare repository'. It misfires both ways.
   Failure: A worktree of a `git init --separate-git-dir` repo (whose common dir is not named `.git`) is told it 'has no main checkout', which is false. A worktree of the common bare-in-`.git` layout (`git clone --bare url .git`) gets main_root Some(<bare parent>) and still names 'the main checkout's tracker', which does not exist.
5. tests/cli.rs:25512 — an_archived_id_is_never_minted_again_while_moves_skip_the_archive asserts only that minting is correct. Nothing checks that `mv` skips the archive scan.
   Failure: Making Reserved::new scan eagerly again (undoing the 2kg laziness) leaves the whole suite green. The perf property that the test's name and the Reserved doc promise is unguarded.
6. src/store.rs:474 — reach now calls worktree::main_root(from), which reads the `.git` file and `commondir` with read_to_string, on every lookup that finds no tracker in its own checkout.
   Failure: Before, find_from read `.git` only for a tracker root it had already found. Now the hook's `cd`/`-C` routing and every run outside a tracker open those files too. A `.git` that is not a regular file (a FIFO) blocks the hook forever, and every tool call pays two extra reads.
7. src/store.rs:126 — climb now stops at a non-directory `.moai` in any ancestor, including ones outside the checkout. A stray `~/.moai` file or dangling link turns every tracker-less directory below it into a `broken` error.
   Failure: With a leftover `~/.moai` file, `moai status` in an unrelated project directory (or the overview of registered projects) exits with code `broken` instead of showing the overview or 'no tracker'. That puts a non-zero exit on a read caused by data that belongs to no tracker. It is consistent with how a config-less `.moai` dir already behaves, so this may be intended.
8. src/archive.rs:170 — archive::board compares `rows == root` element by element even when both arguments are the same slice (a non-overlaid `moai status` passes `&load` twice). The `!archived.issues.is_empty()` gate also leaves the common no-archive case walking group columns twice.
   Failure: Each `moai status` deep-compares every live Issue against itself to decide that the two contexts are the same. In repos without an archive, status_unjudged and movable still each compute the group stands.
9. src/cmd/prime.rs:196 — climbed_away's page says 'No `.moai` here' and offers `moai init` here, but climb skips a `.moai` it cannot stat (Spot::Unseen), and 'here' may be a subdirectory rather than the checkout top.
   Failure: In a checkout whose own `.moai` is permission-denied, prime says there is no `.moai` here. In `proj/src`, following its advice plants a tracker in `src` rather than at the checkout root.

Fixed (src/store.rs, src/archive.rs, tests/cli.rs):
- #1: into_tracker now also refuses a write whose resolved path falls under the resolved `.moai`, `.moai/journal` or archive directory. New CLI test init_never_writes_into_a_tracker_whose_moai_is_a_directory_link covers both link spellings.
- #2: Repo::open's NotADir branch now redirects to the main checkout first, like the Absent branch, and only refuses when there is nowhere to redirect. New unit test a_moai_file_in_a_linked_worktree_opens_the_main_tracker_like_the_lookup.
- #5: Added a test-only Reserved::scanned_yet(). archive_ids_are_reserved_under_the_repository_write_lock now asserts nothing is scanned before the first question and that the scan happens on it.
- #6: reach now runs a stat-only worktree::is_linked(from) check before calling main_root.
- #8: board checks whether both arguments are the same slice before comparing rows. Kept the empty-archive gate, because removing it would clone the rows on the common path.

Skipped:
- #3: needs a general way to recognise a tracker; wider than this diff; on_lock's "issues.jsonl beside it" check doesn't carry over cleanly.
- #4: a correct bare check needs another git call or a read of core.bare, and would undo the rule that init uses the same test as the lookup — a design call.
- #7: looks like the intended e19 behaviour (matches a config-less .moai dir); flagged for a decision.
- #9: page wording in rare cases; left.
- init --check in a worktree with a .moai file still exits 1 — left on purpose: init there refuses with the same message, so passing would recommend a command that fails.

1. src/tui/draw.rs:1854 — banner_line works out the kept prefix as shown.len() - '…'.len_utf8(), which underflows when clip returns an empty string at width 0. Failure: archive view on, an unreadable archive line present, banner rect width 0 (e.g. while a pane is being resized) → usize underflow panics in debug; in release the slice index panics → the TUI crashes.
2. src/tui/mod.rs:4818 — go() closes whichever overlay is open before opening the other, so a failed stats count on the wiki window also closes the wiki and its link trail. Failure: in the wiki, with a hung filter that no longer builds, press SPC g s → stats fails and the wiki window (cursor, links followed) is gone, although the wiki was not stale. The user's decision (moai-ug6x.hr1 note) covers re-reading the same window only.

5. src/tui/mod.rs:850 — board()'s doc says unreadable archive lines appear as notices, but archive_board_unjudged adds them to warnings (and the new Counted doc says warnings); its list of returned values also leaves out archive_unreadable. Failure: a reader trusting board()'s doc expects the count under notices (+N) when it is in warnings (!).
6. src/tui/mod.rs:12403 — the --json half of the a3e test checked only notices and unreadable, not that the whole count stays default (warnings, archive_unreadable). Failure: if the json path started filling archive_unreadable or warnings, the test would stay green.

- 3: the open-path test adds an unreadable archive line, opens through open_counted, and checks unreadable_archive == 1.
- 4: a new layer test, an_opened_row_carries_its_unreadable_archive_lines, expands a project whose archive has an unreadable line and checks the count on its Site.

Left for you:
- 2: closing the wiki when stats fails needs a user decision, because the doc on go() deliberately closes in one place for every case. A narrower option is to close first only when the same window is being reopened, and otherwise let the new window replace the old one only if it opens.
- 7: making Back on Left ignore modifiers would change key behaviour beyond what 3ip set out to do.

# cmux facts (source manaflow-ai/cmux @41d789a1cc07, 2026-10-10; not run)

Env per surface (protected, inherited by claude in that pane), uppercase UUIDs:
CMUX_SURFACE_ID, CMUX_WORKSPACE_ID, CMUX_PANEL_ID(=surface), CMUX_TAB_ID(=workspace!), CMUX_SOCKET_PATH,
CMUX_SOCKET_CAPABILITY, CMUX_TERMINAL_LIFECYCLE_ID, CMUX_CLAUDE_INTEGRATION_DISABLED. TERM_PROGRAM=ghostty (not distinctive).
Detect: CMUX_SURFACE_ID / CMUX_SOCKET_PATH. Always pass --surface explicitly (CMUX_TAB_ID trap).

Model: window > workspace (sidebar "tab") > pane (split) > surface (tab in pane; send/read target).
Handles: UUID or ref surface:N (refs minted lazily, may not survive restart; keep UUIDs). --id-format uuids|both, --json.

Commands:
- cmux --json --id-format both identify [--surface] -> caller{surface_id,...}, focused{...}
- cmux tree [--all] [--json]; list-panes; list-pane-surfaces
- cmux --json top --all --processes -> per surface: id, ref, title, tty, cmux_process_pids (pids whose env has that CMUX_SURFACE_ID)
- cmux sessions list --json [--agent claude] -> hook records: agent session id, workspace id, surface id, cwd, pid, lifecycle (needs cmux Claude integration)
- cmux new-split <left|right|up|down> --surface <id> [--command <text>] [--focus false default] -> prints "OK surface:N workspace:N". No cwd flag: --command 'cd <dir> && claude ...'. Shell stays after command exits.
- cmux send [--surface] [--paste] [--force] -- <text>   (\n \r = Enter, \t Tab; keystrokes)
- cmux send-key [--surface] [--force] -- <key>  (enter, escape, ctrl+c, ctrl+u ...)
- cmux paste [--surface] [--submit] [--force] [-- text | -]  (stdin with -, bracketed, 15MiB, --submit presses return)
- Draft guard: send/paste refuse (non-zero, nothing written) when Claude input row holds a human draft or a dialog is open; send-key refuses on dialog only; --force skips. NEVER pass --force.
- cmux rpc surface.input_state '{"surface_id":"<uuid>"}' -> state empty|draft|dialog|unknown, lifecycle running|idle|needsInput, waiting_on_human, blocks_typing
- cmux read-screen --surface <id> [--lines N]  (alias capture-pane)
- cmux rename-tab --surface <id> --title '<t>' ; rename-workspace ; set-description
- cmux notify --title ... ; trigger-flash --surface
- equalize: cmux rpc workspace.equalize_splits '{"workspace_id":"<uuid>","orientation":"vertical"}' (no CLI verb)
- close-surface (--force kills) — never
- focus-* change what user sees — never unless asked
- cmux agent message <surface> [--from name] -- <text|-> : delivers via Claude hooks (32KiB) no typing; needs cmux Claude integration
Socket: default mode cmuxOnly admits processes descending from cmux (a supervisor inside a pane is fine).
Agent Hibernation may kill idle background agent processes (resumes when tab revisited).

title: guide::SESSIONS 가 /proc 로만 살아 있음을 재 macOS 에서 모든 세션이 dead 로 읽힌다

text:
Findings (2026-10-10). Source: `@buzzni/saycode-cli` 0.8.1 bundled in `@buzzni/happy-cli` 1.1.10-aplus.305 (`node_modules/@buzzni/saycode-cli/index.mjs`). Live test: one haiku worker spawned with the person's yes (`cmv2jw3sz202m1n2fcymuck2h`, depth 1). Nothing was sent to any session the person opened.

Scope and ownership (from the source)
- `prompt`, `read` and `wait` check scope only (same machine, directory under `SAYCODE_AGENT_SCOPE`). Nothing checks ownership, so they reach sibling sessions the person opened. Saycode's "control only proven lineage" line is advice in the system prompt; the CLI does not enforce it.
- `steer` and `stop` check ownership only at depth >= 1 (`not_owned`). At depth 0 they reach any session in scope. `stop` only stops a running response (`stop_not_responding`).
- `ls` includes ended sessions (`state: ended`). `ls --status` states: `ended`, `waiting-input` (AskUserQuestion, ExitPlanMode or a permission request pending), `responding`, `idle`. `lastSeq` is the cursor for `read --since`.
- Lineage ledger: `<scope>/.aplus/agent-lineage.jsonl` (ignored by git here).

Live results
- Spawn returned in about 4 s. The child's first turn ended about 30 s later.
- `wait --until turn-end` counts only a turn that ends after the wait starts. On a session whose turn already ended it blocks until timeout (seen: `wait_timeout`). Default timeout 10 min, max 60 min.
- `prompt --wait` failed with `prompt_stalled` ("no reaction within 5000ms") both times, though the message arrived and was answered. Do not use `--wait`.
- Pattern that worked: start `wait <id> --until turn-end` in the background, then `prompt <id> <text>` without `--wait`, then collect the wait. It returned `satisfied`.
- Two prompts sent back to back to a busy session: both delivered, run as two separate turns in order (ONE, then TWO). A wait started after the second turn ended missed it, so check `ls --status` (`state`, `turnEndedAt`) before waiting.
- `read` returns agent messages only (empty text for tool-only steps); the user's prompts are not in it.
- `prompt <id> /clear` resets the context: asked afterwards for its earlier replies, the worker said NONE. It also restarts the claude process under the same Saycode session, so the worker's ListAgents name changes (`moa-issue-59` after the clear). The Saycode session id stays the same, so the Saycode id is the stable key and the ListAgents name is not.
- The spawned worker also shows in ListAgents as an `interactive` peer. SendMessage to it was not tried.
- Its `~/.claude/sessions/<pid>.json` record says `tmux: moai:@1.%8`, which is the supervisor's own pane: the daemon passes its `TMUX_PANE` down. For a Saycode-spawned session the tmux field is wrong. moai-tmux must not trust it, and would type into the supervisor's pane.
- Bridge from a ListAgents name to a Saycode id: the record's `pid` -> `/proc/<pid>/environ` -> `APLUS_SESSION_ID`.
- The person checked Desktop: the spawned session shows in the project's session list, not in this conversation's child panel.

Spawn details (from the source)
- Without `--worktree` the child starts in `SAYCODE_AGENT_ROOT` (the root here), whatever directory the parent stands in.
- `--worktree` creates `<repo>/.aplus/worktrees/<adjective-animal-xxxx>`. The path cannot be chosen, `--worktree-name` is refused, and a dirty parent tree is refused (`worktree_base_dirty`). That does not fit `.worktrees/moai-<id>`, so spawn without `--worktree` and let the worker make its worktree as the brief says.
- The child runs as `happy claude --happy-starting-mode remote --started-by daemon --dangerously-skip-permissions`; spawn sends no permission mode. The person decided (2026-10-10): allowed, but the question asked before opening says it runs in bypass mode.
- `--file` lists absolute paths inside the scope at the top of the prompt; nothing is uploaded.
- Budget: a rolling 6-hour window, `min(MAX_SPAWN, machine tier)`; failed attempts count too. Depth limit 2.

Recovery
- No `agent` verb revives an ended session. `happy resume <happy-session-id>` runs `claude --resume` (or `codex --resume`) in the saved path, in the foreground. Whether it keeps the same Saycode id is unconfirmed.

What this means for the members
- mqc: sign `SAYCODE_AGENT_ENV=1`. With Saycode first, the tmux skill must not use the tmux field of a session that has `APLUS_SESSION_ID` in its environ.
- ab4: list with `ls --status`; send with background `wait` then plain `prompt`; read the report with `read --since <lastSeq>`. Key workers by Saycode id. `/clear` via `prompt` works (no `--wait`).
- oos: `state: waiting-input` and `pending.*` replace the tmux screen scrape.
- r2b: spawn without `--worktree`; say bypass mode in the question; agent, model and effort from the person, checked against `spawnModelOptions`. Desktop shows it in the session list only.
- nj6: `happy resume`, unverified live.

Person decision (2026-10-10): a worker opened with happy agent spawn runs with --dangerously-skip-permissions (spawn sends no permission mode). Allowed, and the question asked before opening says so. Findings for every member: moai show moai-l244.xw9.

text:
/code-review xhigh --fix milestone/moai-2o4o...HEAD — the reviewer's report (findings verbatim, summary of the fix list).

Checked against this machine: Saycode sessions here are recorded with `entrypoint: remote_mobile`, their stdin is a socket, and both name pane `%8`, which runs bash, not the supervisor. The installed `happy` takes only full model ids for `--model`.

1. src/guide.rs:2331 — The session map blanks a Saycode worker's wrong pane only when two live sessions name it; a lone session started by Saycode's daemon still hands out the daemon's pane as its own. Failure: daemon started from a bash pane (%8), one Saycode worker alive; its row prints %8, so moai-tmux labels and reads the bash pane, and "When a worker stalls" reads the bash prompt as a dead session.
2. src/guide.rs:2779 — The default spawn passes the 2-1 model word (`opus`/`sonnet`/`haiku`) as `--model`, but Saycode accepts only full model ids. Failure: `Unknown claude model "opus"` (invalid_spawn_options); the default path never opens a worker.
3. src/guide.rs:2903 — moai-recover recognised a Saycode session only by matching `lastAgentText`, and only inside Saycode. Failure: a worker killed mid-turn has `lastAgentText: null` and never pairs; outside Saycode the sessions cannot be listed; the session is resumed in a tmux pane with `claude --resume`, outside Saycode, while the Saycode session stays ended.
4. src/guide.rs:2991 — Recovery's "workers first, supervisor last" breaks with Saycode workers. Failure: a plain-pane supervisor is resumed in step 5 while its Saycode workers only get a `happy resume` line in step 7; its ListAgents does not see them.
5. src/guide.rs:2690 — The background `happy agent wait --timeout 3600000` outlives the Bash tool's 30-minute default for background commands. Failure: a turn past 30 minutes; Bash stops the wait; the skill has no rule for a stopped wait.
6. src/guide.rs:2442 — Inside a daemon-started session `$TMUX_PANE` is the daemon's pane. Failure: "your own row is $TMUX_PANE" points at %8; moai-recover's split-window/select-layout act on the daemon's window.
7. src/guide.rs:2733 — "Clear a worker" states the worker reads idle after /clear as a fact. Failure: a check during the restart reads something else and the supervisor sends anyway.
8. src/guide.rs:2666 — A codex or gemini worker opened through Saycode never appears in ListAgents, but the supervisor's 2 picks workers only from ListAgents. Failure: after its first report it is never offered new work. (Not fixed by the reviewer: a design call.)
9. src/guide.rs:2290 — Doc comment, docs/agents.md and CHANGELOG say the shared pane was "the supervisor's own pane"; in the live records %8 runs bash. (Partly fixed: moai-tmux text now says "the pane the daemon was started from"; measurement claims left.)
10. src/guide.rs:5695 — The session-map test copied the /proc start-time parsing twice.

Fixed by the reviewer: 1 (map prints `-` for entrypoint remote_mobile, two-rows rule kept as fallback, test added), 2 (2-1 word maps to the first full id containing it, else `--model` left off), 3 and 4 (Saycode session told by its transcript's entrypoint; never resumed in a pane; supervisor waits for Saycode workers), 5 (Bash timeout 3660000), 6 (caveat in moai-tmux and moai-recover), 7 (send nothing until it reads idle again), 10 (one closure). Docs and the plugin tree regenerated. Also seen, skipped: moai-saycode and moai-tmux share the trigger "open a worker" — harmless, moai-saycode backs out when whoami fails.

title: macOS 에서 시험이 붉다 — tests/cli.rs 컴파일 실패, 단위 시험 다섯

text:
# Mac 실측 (2026-10-11, cmux 0.63.2 (79) 설치본, Claude Code 2.1.296, macOS 26 aarch64)

세션 기록:
- macOS 기록은 `pidDomain: "darwin"`, `procStart` 는 `LC_ALL=C TZ=UTC ps -p <pid> -o lstart=` 와 같은 글
  (`Fri Oct  9 17:24:58 2026` — 날이 한 자리면 빈칸 둘). 산 세션 넷 모두 이 비교로 alive. /proc 는 없다
- 세션 프로세스의 tty(`ps -o tty=`)는 tmux `#{pane_tty}` 와 같다 (%17↔ttys011, %20↔ttys013, %1↔ttys005)
  → tmux 칸 확인을 /proc/<pid>/environ 대신 tty 로 한다(리눅스도 같은 길). guide::SESSIONS 를 그렇게 고쳤다
- 남의 프로세스 환경 읽기(KERN_PROCARGS2 를 python ctypes 로)는 자동 모드 분류기가 "Credential Exploration" 으로 막았다
  — 스킬이 환경을 직접 읽으면 감독도 같은 자리에서 막힐 수 있다. 환경 읽기는 cmux 자신(`top`)에 맡긴다

cmux 0.63.2:
- 소켓은 `~/Library/Application Support/cmux/cmux.sock` (CMUX_SOCKET_PATH, /tmp/cmux.sock 아님), access_mode cmuxOnly
- env: CMUX_SURFACE_ID=CMUX_PANEL_ID, CMUX_WORKSPACE_ID=CMUX_TAB_ID, CMUX_CLAUDE_PID(=claude pid, cmux 의 claude 래퍼가 export)
- 없다: `top`, `paste`, `sessions`, `agent message`, rpc `surface.input_state`, 초안 가드. `new-split` 은 `--command` 를 말없이 버리고 포커스를 뺏는다
- 있다: read-screen --surface --lines, rename-tab --surface, send, send-key, set-buffer/paste-buffer, rpc workspace.equalize_splits
- `tree --json` 의 surface 별 `tty` 는 낡은 값이 섞인다(ttys023 을 surface:3 과 surface:21 이 함께 주장, 실제 주인은 21) → tty 로 surface 를 잇지 못한다
- Claude Code 는 탭 제목을 OSC 로 계속 쓴다("✳ <화제>", 스피너 글리프)

소스 판별(서브에이전트, manaflow-ai/cmux v0.63.2·v0.65.0·main@41d789a1cc07):
- top(cmux_process_pids, cmux 가 KERN_PROCARGS2 로 CMUX_SURFACE_ID/CMUX_PANEL_ID 를 읽음): v0.64.0+. `--processes` 없이도 채워진다
- paste(--surface --submit --force, `-`=stdin)·surface.input_state·초안 가드: v0.65.0+ (v0.64.x 에 없음). main 은 v0.65.0 과 같다
- 초안 가드가 실제로 막는 것은 `blocks_typing = agent && (draft||dialog)` — agent 는 cmux 의 Claude 훅(래퍼가 --settings 로 심음)이 채운다.
  훅 없이 띄운 claude 는 state=draft 여도 막지 않는다 → 스킬이 state 를 스스로 읽어야 한다
- new-split --command(초기 입력 text+CR, 셸에 쳐 넣음 → claude 가 끝나도 셸이 남는다)는 v0.64.23+, --focus(기본 false)는 v0.64.0+. CLI 에 --cwd 없음
- 결론: 사람 결정(top 다리·paste·input_state)대로 쓰려면 cmux >= 0.65.0 이 바닥이다

title: review — moai-p5sz cmux 스킬 에픽 끝

text:
Next: 실기 확인 — cmux 를 0.65.0 이상으로 올린 뒤(올리면 cmux 안의 세션이 다 다시 선다, 사람이 고를 때). 글과 시험은 v0.65.0 소스로 지었다(2026-10-11 사용자 결정: 바닥 0.65.0, 글 먼저·확인 나중).
시험 탭은 사람에게 묻고 연다. 하나씩, 붙이기 전에 빈 칸부터:
1. `cmux capabilities` 의 methods 에 surface.input_state 가 선다
2. guide::SESSIONS 를 cmux 안(tmux 밖)에서 돌리면 제 줄의 pane 이 $CMUX_SURFACE_ID 다(top --id-format both 의 id·cmux_process_pids)
3. `cmux --id-format both new-split right --surface "$CMUX_SURFACE_ID" --command 'cd <scratch> && claude --model sonnet'` — 첫 UUID 가 새 surface 인가, 포커스를 안 뺏는가, cd 가 먹는가
4. 새 탭의 `cmux rpc surface.input_state '{"surface_id":"<uuid>"}'` — Claude 가 막 떴을 때와 /clear 뒤의 자리글(흐린 글)이 state empty 로 읽히는가, 초안을 치면 draft 인가, 권한 물음이면 waiting_on_human 인가
5. `cmux rename-tab --surface <uuid> --title 'w1 moai-xxxx'` 가 Claude 의 OSC 제목에 안 덮이는가, `cmux tab-action --surface <uuid> --action clear-name` 이 Claude 제목으로 돌려놓는가
6. `cmux send --surface <uuid> -- '/clear\n'` 이 /clear 를 치고 누르는가(\n 이 Enter 인가, 슬래시 메뉴가 끼어들지 않는가)
7. `cmux paste --surface <uuid> --submit -- - < <여러 줄 파일>` 이 Claude 칸에서 실제로 제출되는가(소스상 Claude·여러 줄이면 ctrl+enter 로 친다)
8. 초안이 선 칸에 paste 를 치면 거절하는가 — cmux 의 Claude 훅이 선 탭과 아닌 탭 둘 다
9. `cmux rpc workspace.equalize_splits '{"workspace_id":"<uuid>"}'` 가 고르게 하는가
10. 시험 탭은 사람이 닫는다(스킬은 close-surface 를 안 가르친다)
어긋난 것은 guide::cmux()·CMUX_EMPTY_BOX·recover() 를 고치고 이 이슈를 닫는다.

탭 제목만 단다 — 워크스페이스 이름은 안 바꾼다. 워크스페이스 한 줄에 감독과 일꾼 여럿이 서고 사이드바의 이름은 사람의 것이라서다. rename-tab 의 custom title 은 Claude 의 OSC 제목을 이기고(v0.65.0 resolvedPanelTitle), 걷는 길은 tab-action --action clear-name. 바퀴마다 다느냐를 묻고, Claude 의 제목(상태 글리프)도 이 바퀴의 이름표도 아닌 제목의 탭은 사람이 붙인 이름일 수 있어 둔다.

tmux 칸 확인을 /proc/<pid>/environ 의 TMUX 소켓 비교에서 #{pane_tty} 와 ps -o tty= 비교로 바꿨다(리눅스도). macOS 에 그 파일이 없고, 남의 프로세스 환경 읽기는 자동 모드 분류기가 막았다(2026-10-11, 이 세션의 ctypes 시도가 거절됨). cmux 쪽 다리는 사람 결정대로 cmux top 의 cmux_process_pids — 환경은 cmux 가 읽는다.

title: macOS 의 세션 짝 — moai-tmux·moai-recover 가 Mac 에서 세션을 못 찾는다
macOS 에서 세션 짝이 모든 세션을 dead 로 읽는다

text: 이 고침(72b6db10)이 moai-kccu.l73 (v0.13.1, Mac 의 다른 세션이 보낸 버그 리포트)의 답이다. 그 판으로 따로 내려면 이 커밋을 옮긴다.

/code-review max --fix (opus, 세 번째 시도 — 앞의 둘은 사용량 한도로 끊겼고, 둘째가 반쯤 적용한 고침은 보관 뒤 되돌렸다). 리뷰어의 말:

The review found 15 issues worth reporting and I fixed all of them in the working tree; nothing is committed. Two are serious enough to block a merge without the fixes: the supervisor's paste command typed a lone `-` instead of the message, and a tab whose Claude Code had died could still look like an empty input box, so a paste would run in the shell. cmux behaviour was checked against the v0.65.0 source only. The cmux installed here is 0.63.2, and I ran no cmux command that changes anything.

1. src/guide.rs:2829 — moai-cmux delivery and moai-recover section 6 (line 3101) taught `cmux paste --surface <surface> --submit -- - < <file>`, which pastes and submits a lone `-` instead of the file. In cmux v0.65.0 (CMUXCLI+Paste.swift) anything after `--` is the text itself; stdin is read only for a lone `-` before `--`. So a worker whose SendMessage failed gets the prompt `-`, and every session moai-recover brings back starts a turn on `-` instead of its recovery note.
2. src/guide.rs:2633 — The cmux empty-box check trusted `state: empty`, but cmux judges that from the screen alone. A tab whose Claude Code was killed still shows its last box above a shell prompt and reads `empty`. A worker dies, so SendMessage fails with 'no such session'. The supervisor runs `paste --submit` into that tab and zsh runs the message as a script. The same happens in recover §6 when a resumed session is OOM-killed again. cmux's own code says to act on this only for a surface known to run an agent.
3. src/guide.rs:2390 — When the shell could not read process start times, the session map printed every record as `dead`, the caller's own row included, and exited 0. Claude Code's macOS Bash sandbox (or a Linux sandbox with its own pid namespace) hides other processes from `ps`. moai-recover's check that drops a session that is already back cannot fire, so it runs `claude --resume` on live sessions and one conversation ends up in two windows. Reproduced with a `ps` that sees nothing.
4. src/guide.rs:2392 — In cmux mode the map gave a surface to every live record cmux attributes to it, and cmux attributes processes only by the inherited CMUX_SURFACE_ID. Two sessions inside zellij or screen in one cmux tab, or a `kind: bg` record that inherited the tab, all print the same surface. `/clear` or a paste meant for one worker lands in whichever session has the tab's input.
5. src/guide.rs:3090 — Every new pane was `new-split right` off the caller's tab, and neither recover §6 nor 'No idle worker left' (line 2870) handled cmux refusing a split. cmux refuses a split that would leave a pane narrower than 160pt (Workspace+SplitSpace.swift), so the splits run out after about 4-6 panes. `new-split` also pins the CMUX_WORKSPACE_ID from when the session started, so it fails after the tab moves. Recover opens the supervisor last, so the supervisor is silently never brought back.
6. src/guide.rs:2769 — Labels used `cmux rename-tab` and `tab-action clear-name`, and those commands always add the caller's $CMUX_WORKSPACE_ID. The server looks in the supervisor's workspace first and answers 'Tab not found', so a worker tab in another sidebar workspace can never be labelled or unlabelled. `cmux rpc tab.action` with only `surface_id` finds the workspace from the surface.
7. src/guide.rs:2779 — The label and the person's own tab name share one custom-title slot, and the title was read only before labelling, never before `clear_name`. If the person renames the tab while the worker runs, the report check erases their name. A label left by a supervisor that later restarted is never recognised as a label, so it is never cleared.
8. src/guide.rs:2123 — Supervisor step 3 said to label the worker's tab on every send, while moai-cmux says to ask the person first. A supervisor following step 3 rewrites the visible titles of tabs the person is looking at without asking.
9. src/guide.rs:2349 — The tmux pane check began running procps `ps -p <pid> -o tty=` on Linux too, where the old map read only /proc. On Debian-slim images (no procps) or BusyBox `ps` (no `-p`), every live tmux row prints `-`. Reproduced in a node:22 container with `ps` removed.
10. src/guide.rs:2325 — `subprocess.run(capture_output=True, text=True)` needs Python 3.7, and the code catches only OSError. On Python 3.6 (RHEL 8, Ubuntu 18.04) it raises TypeError and the map dies with a traceback partway through the rows.
11. src/guide.rs:2698 — Any failing `cmux capabilities` was read as 'cmux is too old', and a failed `cmux top` was swallowed silently. With an unreachable socket, the person is told to update cmux, and an update restarts every session in it. Meanwhile every pane reads `-` with no reason given.
12. src/guide.rs:2833 — The skill did not say what to do when `paste --submit` pastes the text but cannot press the submit key; cmux warns on stderr and exits 0. The message sits unsent in the worker's box (the report never comes), or a retry pastes it a second time.
13. src/guide.rs:5888 — The new test's private tmux server started without `-f /dev/null`, so it loaded the developer's ~/.tmux.conf. `cargo test` runs the person's tmux plugins and hooks; tmux-continuum, for example, would restore saved sessions into the test server and then kill them.
14. src/guide.rs:5882 — The test socket under $TMPDIR measured 103 bytes on this Mac, which is the macOS limit for a socket path. One more digit in the pid, thread id or counter makes `tmux new-session` fail and the test panic.
15. src/guide.rs:2632 — The cmux empty-box rule quoted the literal JSON `"state": "empty"` and called `waiting_on_human` a pending prompt. `cmux rpc` prints `"state" : "empty"` (space before the colon), so a literal match never succeeds. `waiting_on_human` comes from the hook's lifecycle state, which an API error also sets, so the stall report misleads.

What I fixed:
- Session map: on Linux the tty comes from /proc/<pid>/stat and is compared by device number with the pane, so ps is only used on macOS; Python 3.6; a stderr line when `cmux top` gives no answer; in tmux and cmux mode non-interactive records get no pane, and a pane two live sessions claim prints `-`; when no record reads alive it prints nothing and exits 1 telling the reader to act on no row.
- moai-cmux and moai-recover: paste is `--submit - < <file>`; the empty-box rule also requires a fresh session-map look showing that session alive in that tab; labels go through `cmux rpc tab.action`, and the title is read again before a label comes off; both split steps say what to do when cmux refuses (in recover, the sessions left, supervisor included, get lines to type); both paste steps handle the 'pasted but not submitted' warning; the version check says an error is not an old version; supervisor step 3 asks before labelling.
- Lower-priority, also fixed: contradicting wording across the supervisor, moai-tmux and moai-cmux intros; a weakened test in init_choice.rs; the cmux test requires five citations, recover's cmux "never" line pinned; the recover change moved to a `### Changed` CHANGELOG section; the draft-guard claim (skill and docs/agents.md) says it only works for sessions cmux's hook knows; a misplaced doc comment, a stale doc and test in skill.rs; titles read with the text form of `tree`; the AGENTS-block sentence about planting optional skills names moai-cmux too.
- Tests: socket moved to a short /tmp scratch dir, server starts with `-f /dev/null`, new tests for the shared-tab, bg and no-alive cases. Plugin copies re-blessed, AGENTS.md hash recomputed.

Left alone:
- `cmux claude-teams` sets a fake `$TMUX`, so a supervisor started that way routes to moai-tmux. Fixing it needs a decision on how the supervisor chooses between tmux and cmux.
- tmux empty-box check has the same dead-frame weakness, but it is outside this diff.
- Duplicated text between moai-recover and moai-cmux.
- Commit 94b973a1 bundles the regenerated copies; history isn't rewritten mid-review.
- Running `ps` once per record, and timeouts on the map's subprocesses.

Testing: cargo test --bin moai 1988 pass, 5 fail (the same 5 macOS-only as before); fmt and clippy -D warnings clean; the map's Linux path ran in a throwaway node:22 container with and without ps; its macOS path ran against the real tmux panes here.

text: /code-review low --fix. 리뷰어의 말: I found nothing to fix (`(none)`), so I made no edits. The change takes `--` out of the two `chmod 644 "$tmp"` calls in scripts/bump-version.sh and adds a comment saying why. Without the `--`, a file name starting with `-` could be read as an option, but that can't happen here: `mktemp` always builds `$tmp` from `$manifest.tmp.XXXXXX`, and `$manifest` doesn't start with `-`. The `--` on the `mv` and `rm` calls was left in place, which is correct. Those flags work the same on macOS and Linux, so only `chmod` needed changing. This was a low-level review: I read the diff once, skipped the test files and didn't run anything.

조사(2026-10-11, cmux 0.65.0 소스 + 실기 `cmux __debug-tmux-compat-env`):
- claude-teams(그리고 omo·omx·omc)는 가짜 TMUX=/tmp/cmux-<접두어>/<워크스페이스 UUID>,<창>,<칸 숫자>, TMUX_PANE=%<숫자>, TERM=screen-256color 를 세우고 PATH 앞에 tmux shim(→ cmux __tmux-compat)을 둔다. 접두어는 cmux-claude-teams·cmux-omo·cmux-omx·cmux-omc(디버그는 cmux-debug). CMUX_SURFACE_ID·CMUX_WORKSPACE_ID 는 그 탭의 것으로 그대로 선다
- 지금 그 감독은 $TMUX 가 서니 moai-tmux 로 간다. shim 은 set-option 을 아무것도 안 하고 0 으로 받아(이름표가 말없이 안 선다), load-buffer 는 'Unsupported tmux compatibility command' 로 거절한다. display -p '#{pane_tty}' 는 그 꼴을 모른다 — 짝의 tmux 갈래가 모든 칸을 - 로 내서, 결국 감독은 일꾼 칸에 아무것도 못 한다(위험하지는 않고 쓸모가 없다)
- 진짜 tmux 의 소켓은 /tmp/cmux-… 에 서지 않는다(tmux-<uid>/…) — 접두어로 가려도 진짜 tmux 를 cmux 로 잘못 읽을 길은 없다. 다만 cmux 의 문서에 없는 안쪽 꼴이라 다음 판에서 바뀔 수 있다(바뀌면 지금처럼 쓸모없는 쪽으로 돌아간다)

text:
Summary: /code-review xhigh --fix (사람 결정으로 max 를 멈추고 xhigh, 앞의 max 둘은 한도로 끊김). 아래는 최종 보고와, 같은 회차의 하위 관점 보고 여덟의 지적을 번호·자리째 줄인 것.

리뷰어의 최종 보고(10건, 8건 고침):
1. src/guide.rs:2714 — moai-cmux 의 설명은 '(CMUX_SURFACE_ID is set and $TMUX is not)', moai-tmux(2461)는 '($TMUX is set)' — Claude Code 는 설명으로 스킬을 고르니 claude-teams 감독이 moai-tmux 를 고른다. [고침]
2. src/skill.rs:59 — OPTIONAL 의 moai-tmux 표식이 이름만 봐 init 화면이 claude-teams 셸에서 moai-tmux 를 미리 켠다. [고침: sign 이 값도 받고 CMUX_STAND_IN]
3. src/guide.rs:1845 — 감독 첫 문단이 '$TMUX 가 서면 moai-tmux' 라고만 한다. [고침]
4. tests/cli.rs:22044 — 2초 PROBE_BUDGET 안에 막 놓은 실행 파일을 재는 시험 가운데 하나만 데웠다 — status_names_a_wrapper…(4판 중 2), status_names_another_tool…(1), undeclaring…(같은 노출). [고침: warm_exe]
5. src/guide.rs:2392 — cmux 짝은 tmux 가 선 기록을 - 로 내는데 claude-teams 세션은 가짜 tmux 를 든다 — 그 일꾼과 감독 제 줄이 - 이고 moai-cmux 는 말이 없었다. [글로 고침, 코드는 사람 결정이 들어 둠]
6. src/skill.rs:538 — command 의 주석 '단순 명령은 한 자식에서 exec' 가 set +e 뒤로 낡았다. [고침]
7. src/skill.rs:1922 — set +e 없이 126 이 1 로 무너지는 것은 bash 3.2 뿐이라 CI 가 못 잡는다. [고침: 글자 핀]
8. src/guide.rs:3005 — 되살리기가 '짝' 이 무엇인지 안 댄다. [고침]
9. src/scratch.rs:66 — base() 가 늘 풀린 철자라 Scratch::real 이 겹친다. [안 고침: 21자리]
10. src/guide.rs:2440 — EMPTY_BOX 가 'exec bash 의 셸' 이라 하는데 사람이 연 칸은 제 로그인 셸이다. [안 고침: 글만]
손대지 않음: 제품의 2초 PROBE_BUDGET 이 macOS 의 첫 실행에 걸리는 것(설계).
확인: fmt·clippy -D warnings 깨끗, 단위 1993, 통합 782 세 번 내리.

하위 관점 보고(같은 회차, 중복 줄임):
- 재사용: scratch::pick 과 Scratch::real 의 이중(scratch.rs:161), /tmp/cmux- 글자가 다섯 자리(guide.rs:2366), 갈래 글이 자리마다 따로(2714·2461·1845·2997·docs 432), OPTIONAL 이 값을 못 봄(skill.rs:59), EILSEQ 잣대 둘(guide.rs:4753·read_marks.rs:2459), tui 의 stat 분기(tui.rs:1627 — cp -p 로), EMPTY_BOX·CMUX_EMPTY_BOX 의 같은 문장 둘(guide.rs:2433), warm-up 이 isolated() 밖(tests/cli.rs:22004)
- 단순화: 갈래를 한 상수로(guide.rs:1860), Scratch::real(scratch.rs:161), openpty 는 &mut size 로(tests/cli.rs:24775), 같은 문장 둘(guide.rs:2432), set +e 를 줄 머리에 한 번(skill.rs:833 — 고장 아님), cp -p(tui.rs:1627), EILSEQ 도움 함수(read_marks.rs:2459)
- 규약: 1vt 의 위키 토막이 코드 커밋에 실림(docs/agents.md:478), In tmux 절이 낡음(432), Decided in 에 이 에픽이 없음(622), 멤버 넷의 집기가 develop 에 커밋 안 됨(issues.jsonl)
- 감싸기·실음(E): moai-tmux 의 '짝은 한 번' 이 '치기 직전에 다시' 와 맞섬(guide.rs:2518, cmux 2799), 감독 첫 문단·설명(1845·2461·2714), OPTIONAL(skill.rs:59), 되살리기의 'Inside tmux:' 머리말(2997, 낮음)
- 효율: set +e; 가 bash 5.0 에서 훅마다 자식 하나(skill.rs:833 — `set +e &&` 면 없다, 소스로 빌드해 잼), command 주석의 '프로세스 안 는다' 가 bash 3.2·4.4 에서는 원래 틀렸다(skill.rs:531)
- 교차 파일(C): claude-teams 셸에서 TMUX_OWN·규칙 4 의 -L 이 shim 에서 버려져 kill-session 이 사람의 워크스페이스를 닫을 수 있다(guide.rs:1071, hook.rs:6434), 세션 짝 시험이 그 셸에서 사람의 cmux 에 워크스페이스를 세운다(guide.rs:5957), Codex 줄의 set +e 는 쓸모없이 Codex 의 훅 믿음을 푼다(skill.rs:833), 되살리기 5절이 되살린 세션의 짝 칸이 - 로 남으면 영영 안 붙인다(guide.rs:3117), docs·cli 도움말이 낡음(docs/agents.md:432·184, cli.rs:925)
- 제거된 동작(B): Codex 믿음(skill.rs:833), 갈래 글(1845…), '프로세스 안 는다' 주석(skill.rs:530), pick 시험이 리눅스에서 못 실패함(scratch.rs:358)
- 줄 단위(A): 감독 첫 문단(1845), 설명(2714), docs 432, moai-tmux 멈춘 일꾼 절이 죽은 칸의 남은 화면을 모름(guide.rs:2607), OPTIONAL(skill.rs:59), -ec 의 맨 '126'(skill.rs:2089 — (exit 126) 로), pick 시험(scratch.rs:358)
- 언어 함정(D): -ec 의 맨 '126'(skill.rs:2089), bash 5.0 의 자식 하나(skill.rs:833, 5.0·5.2 를 빌드해 잼), pick 시험(scratch.rs:358)
- 높이: claude-teams 일꾼의 줄이 cmux 짝에서 늘 -(guide.rs:2401), 규칙 4·TMUX_OWN 의 shim 위험(guide.rs:5958), p56 은 글의 걸음이라 remain-on-exit 가 더 일반(guide.rs:2432), warm-up 은 제품의 PROBE_BUDGET 문제를 시험에서만 덮는다(tests/cli.rs:22004), pick 시험(scratch.rs:360)

내 판단:
- 받은 것: 리뷰가 고친 8건(ad340066)과, 하위 보고가 함께 짚었는데 리뷰가 빠뜨린 것(8d6cf657·5ec8d3ee) — Codex 줄에서 set +e 를 뺌(.codex/hooks.json 이 에픽 전과 같다), set +e 를 && 로(bash 5.0), -ec 를 (exit 126) 꼴로, pick 시험에 일부러 지은 링크, '짝은 한 번' 을 '치기 직전에 한 번 더' 로(두 스킬), moai-tmux 멈춘 일꾼 절과 '산 줄이 없으면' 줄, 되살리기 5절의 되살린 칸이 - 일 때, 세션 짝 시험이 가짜 TMUX 아래에서 진짜 tmux 를 안 띄움, docs/agents.md·init 도움말·docs/cli.md·Decided in
- 진행 기록: 멤버 넷의 집기·리뷰 칸을 develop 에 커밋했다(e4785bb1, 규약 관점의 지적)
- 넘긴 것: moai-royr(claude-teams 셸에서 규칙 4 의 -L 통과가 사람의 cmux 워크스페이스를 닫을 수 있다 — 훅을 바꿔야 해 따로), moai-yt9h(claude-teams 로 띄운 일꾼의 줄이 늘 -), moai-ibtj(스킬이 여는 칸에 remain-on-exit), moai-irmd(제품의 PROBE_BUDGET 이 macOS 첫 실행에 걸림)
- 안 고친 것과 까닭: Scratch::real 의 겹침(21자리를 건드리는 정리라 값이 작다), /tmp/cmux- 글자와 빈 칸 문장을 한 상수로(skill.rs 의 CMUX_STAND_IN 이 코드 쪽 하나를 쥐고, 글은 시험이 자리마다 맨다 — 정리 몫), EILSEQ 도움 함수·tui 의 stat 분기·openpty 의 &mut size(돌고 있고 정리 몫), read_marks 시험의 이른 돌아감(APFS 에서는 설 수 없는 뿌리라 잴 것이 없다), 'exec bash' 낱말, 1vt 의 위키 토막이 코드 커밋에 실린 것(리뷰 중 역사를 안 고친다)
- 시험: macOS 에서 단위 1993·통합 782 모두 푸르다. 리눅스 CI 는 PR 에서 처음 본다(tests/cli.rs 의 openpty·ioctl)

text: model: anthropic/fable-5-1 (high — v0.16.0 계획: 에픽 셋·멤버 열여섯·backlog 다섯, 코드 file:line 확인)

Design delta: no new Warning builder was added; the existing `Warning::count(n)` already sets count apart from ids, so the 3rd status() block uses `Warning::new(..ids_of(&wip)).count(bundles).limit(..)`. Bundle key = in_epic.at(row) else report::fold_top (parent chain top) else own id. Only the warning count changed; wip/started untouched.

Design delta: the epic named in the line is `report::Handing::of(issues).at(thought)` (the epic the backlog stood under). When the milestone differs from the own field but the backlog has no epic (inherited from an ancestor issue/milestone parent), say_if_inherited stays silent - the text says "the epic", so nothing is claimed that is not true. Rare path; not covered by a test. Also: AGENTS.md block was stale at v0.14.0 before this change (init rewrote it to v0.15.1 hash 81751eac), so the AGENTS.md diff is only my paragraph. plugin.json version hash changed by MOAI_BLESS as expected.

사람의 결정 (2026-10-12, 계획의 "사람에게 물을 것" 에 대한 답)

1. max 를 남긴다 — 에픽 끝 기본은 opus `/code-review xhigh --fix`, EPIC_MAX(쓰기 경로·동시성·저장 형식·훅)와 BUNDLE(에픽 둘에 걸친 묶음)만 max. 사다리는 xhigh·max 둘
2. 에픽 밖 이슈 하나의 리뷰는 난이도 사다리 유지 — 등급 low/medium/high, 모델은 low·medium → develop(sonnet), high → review(opus)
3. 세션(ListAgents/SendMessage) 길을 서브에이전트 길과 나란히 둔다 — 기본은 서브에이전트, 사람이 창을 보고 싶을 때와 Codex 일꾼은 세션 길
4. (권장대로) 서브에이전트 일꾼의 `model:` 줄은 감독이 끝난 알림의 subagent_tokens 로 한 줄 적는다
5. (권장대로) 리뷰는 일꾼의 중첩 서브에이전트로 — 되는지는 fxp 가 잰다. 안 되면 감독이 opus 리뷰 서브에이전트를 따로 띄운다
6. (권장대로) `[models]` 는 새 명령 `moai models` 로 읽는다
7. (권장대로) init 선택 상자(moai-4cn9)·저장소 표(moai-6vlv)는 이번 판에 안 넣는다 — backlog 로 둔다

Where to measure (person, 2026-10-12): tmux on its own server only (env -u TMUX tmux -L <unique name>), and in cmux exactly one new tab opened for this survey and closed when done. Do not touch existing cmux tabs or the person's tmux server.
model: anthropic/sonnet-5.5 tokens=216754 (high — j6v·nmu·fg4·tpk 구현과 문서, 서브에이전트 일꾼 하나)

note: 사람이 일 보내기를 멈췄다(토큰) — 아무도 시작 안 함

text:
Next: 구현은 끝났다 — 가지 worktree-moai-rs3o (.worktrees/moai-rs3o), 커밋 d4743987(j6v)·024aa615(nmu)·5d0c50d0(fg4)·fb5e1f5c(tpk). cargo fmt·clippy·test 모두 푸름(단위 1998, CLI 785).
남은 것:
- 에픽 끝 리뷰: opus `/code-review xhigh --fix`. 쓰기 경로·훅 파일은 안 건드렸다(nmu 는 report.rs 의 경고 셈만, 훅 판정은 그 결과로만 달라진다) → max 아님. 리뷰 이슈를 --parent moai-rs3o 로 세우고, 도는 동안 멤버를 review 칸으로
- 리뷰가 볼 것: fg4 의 say_if_inherited 는 에픽이 없는 backlog(조상 이슈에서 물려받은 경우)에서 말하지 않는다 — 시험 없는 길. fg4 가 AGENTS.md 를 v0.14.0 → v0.15.1 로 다시 지었다(이미 낡아 있었다)
- 그 뒤 milestone/moai-fmge 에 --no-ff 병합(.worktrees/milestone-moai-fmge 에서), 워크트리와 /tmp/cargo-target/moai-rs3o 걷기, 멤버 넷 done

fxp 결과 (2026-10-12, 조사 일꾼 = opus 서브에이전트, 스크래치 저장소 + sonnet 중첩 프로브 하나)

재는 자리: Claude Code 2.1.296, macOS. 이 저장소에는 moai 의 Claude 플러그인이 안 깔려 있다
(`moai skill status`: "install none", installed_plugins.json 에 이 경로 없음) — 그래서 moai 훅은 이 세션에서
아무것도 안 섰고, 1·2 는 코드 경로로 판정했다.

1. 훅이 서브에이전트 부름에도 서는가
- 사실: 사용자 범위 PostToolUse 훅(claude-memory-layer)이 이 서브에이전트의 Bash 부름을 기록했다
  (`memory/tool_observation/uncategorized/2026-10-12.md` 에 이 일꾼의 description 들이 선다). 설정 훅은
  서브에이전트의 도구 부름에도 선다
- 사실: moai 훅의 `Input`(src/hook.rs:90-106)은 `session_id`·`cwd`·`source`·`tool_name`·`tool_input`·
  `stop_hook_active` 만 읽는다. `agent_id`·`agent_type` 은 안 읽는다 — 본문이 댄 `guard_subagent_mail` 과
  `Input.agent_id` 는 d09534d2(moai-5uwh.yhx, v0.9.0 우편함 걷기)에서 함께 걷혔다. 그래서 moai 는
  서브에이전트의 부름을 부모(감독) 세션의 부름과 못 가른다 — session_id 가 같아 집기 기록(picks)도 감독
  세션 이름으로 쌓인다
- 사실(코드): 서브에이전트의 Bash cwd 는 늘 루트로 돌아가니 훅의 `cwd`·`root` 도 루트다. 일꾼이
  `<root>/.worktrees/<epic>/…` 를 절대 경로로 Edit 하거나 `cd <wt> && sed -i` 해도 첫 조각이 `.worktrees`
  라 규칙 2 는 세지 않는다(src/hook.rs:8387 `SKIP`, 8402 `counted`) — 막지도 지키지도 않는다
- 사실(코드): 규칙 5 는 담당을 git config 의 사람으로 가른다 — 서브에이전트도 같은 사람이라 제 줄의
  `mv --from todo` 는 지나고, 남의 줄·담당 없는 줄은 `--take` 없이 막힌다. 서브에이전트는 사람에게 못
  물으니 그때는 보고하고 멈춰야 한다
- 못 잼: 규칙 1·3 이 서브에이전트에서 실제로 어떻게 판정되는지(초점은 감독 자리 = 루트 기준이고,
  일꾼의 에픽은 워크트리가 선 뒤 "옆 워크트리" 로 빠진다). 플러그인이 깔린 저장소에서 따로 재야 한다

2. 감독의 Stop 훅
- 사실(코드): moai 는 `Stop` 만 심는다(src/skill.rs:285, plugin.json) — `SubagentStop` 은 없다. 서브에이전트의
  끝은 moai 가 붙들지 않는다(닫기 물음 없음)
- 사실(코드): 감독의 `Stop` 은 `holding`(src/hook.rs:8141)→`held`(5647)로 재고, 제 이름은 세션 자리(루트)의
  워크트리에서 읽는다(src/cmd/hook.rs:751 `away_of`). 일꾼의 에픽이 `.worktrees/` 에 서면 옆의 것이라 안
  붙든다. 걸음 2(집기)와 3(워크트리) 사이에 감독 턴이 끝나면 붙든다 — 세션에 한 번(`stop_hook_active`)
- 못 잼: 실제 붙듦(플러그인 없음)

3. 절대 경로 / 워크트리
- 사실: Bash 의 `cd` 는 그 부름 안에서만 산다 — `cd <scratch>/repo && …` 다음 부름의 `pwd` 는 루트였다
- 사실: `git -C <abs> worktree add`, `git -C <abs> commit`, 절대 경로 Read/Edit 가 워크트리에서 문제없이 섰다
- 사실: `EnterWorktree(path: <스크래치 워크트리>)` 는 거절됐다 — "the current working directory … is the
  repository root, not an isolated worktree — switching is only available to sessions whose working directory
  is inside a worktree of this repository." 도구 설명도 고정된 에이전트에서는 `.claude/worktrees/` 밑만
  받는다고 한다. 서브에이전트 일꾼은 EnterWorktree/ExitWorktree 를 못 쓴다 → 절대 경로 길이 유일하다
  (p1p 전제 성립)

4. 중첩 리뷰
- 사실: 서브에이전트(나, opus)에게 `Agent` 가 있고 `model:"sonnet", effort:"low"` 로 중첩 에이전트를
  세웠다(받아들여짐). 중첩 에이전트에게도 `Agent`·`Skill` 이 있고 `code-review` 가 스킬 목록에 선다
- 사실: 중첩 에이전트가 `Skill(code-review, "low --fix <워크트리 절대 경로>")` 를 불렀다. 스킬은 그
  자리에서 돌지 않고 **포크한 백그라운드 에이전트**(`@code-review`)로 떴다 — 경로 대상(스크래치 워크트리)을
  리뷰해 u8 범위 넘침을 찾았고, `--fix` 가 작업 트리에 고침을 남겼다(` M a.rs`, 커밋 안 함)
- 사실: 그 포크의 모델은 부른 쪽의 모델이다 — 포크 기록의 `model` 이 전부 `claude-sonnet-5-5`. "리뷰는
  창의 모델을 물려받는다" 가 서브에이전트에서도 맞다 → 리뷰를 opus 로 돌리려면 `Agent(model:"opus")` 안에서
  불러야 한다(에픽 설계 성립)
- 사실: 포크는 백그라운드다 — 리뷰 서브에이전트가 포크의 끝을 기다린 뒤 보고해야 한다(REVIEW_BRIEF 에
  "포크가 끝난 알림을 받은 뒤 트리를 읽고 handback" 을 적는다)
- 사실: 끝난 에이전트에 `TaskStop` 은 "is not running (status: completed)" 로 무해하게 거절된다
- 못 잼: 돌고 있는 리뷰 포크를 손자 쪽에서 `TaskStop` 으로 멈추는 것

5. 물음
- 사실: 이 일꾼과 중첩 프로브 둘 다 `AskUserQuestion` 이 없다(ToolSearch 로 찾아도 없음).
  `SubagentHandback`·`SendMessage`(지연)·`TaskStop`(지연)은 있다
- 사실: 끝난 에이전트에 `SendMessage(to: <agentId>)` → "Resuming agent …" 이고, 처음 프롬프트에서만 준
  암호와 앞 턴에서 본 포크 id 를 그대로 답했다 — 같은 기록에서 잇는다. `Agent` 에 이름 인자가 없어
  주소는 agentId 다(spawn 결과에 선다)
- 사실: handback 은 부모에게 `<agent-message from="<agentId>">` 로 따로 오고, 끝난 알림의 `<result>` 는
  "delivered to you as a message" 라고만 한다 — 보고 본문은 메시지에서, 수치는 알림에서 읽는다

6. 토큰
- 사실: 부모(나)가 받은 끝난 알림에 `<usage><subagent_tokens>69707</subagent_tokens><tool_uses>3</tool_uses>
  <duration_ms>57407</duration_ms></usage>` 가 섰다. 감독이 앞선 계획 에이전트의 알림에서 같은 셋을 받은 것과 같다
- 사실: 그 수는 **중첩 자식을 안 센다** — 프로브의 마지막 턴 합(입력+캐시+출력)이 69208, 리뷰 포크의 것이
  65790 인데 알림은 69707. 일꾼 알림의 tokens 에 리뷰 서브에이전트의 몫은 없다
- 사실: 그 수는 쌓인 합이 아니라 **마지막 맥락 크기에 가깝다** — 이어 깨운 뒤의 알림은 70123(+416),
  tool_uses 4, duration 77997 로 둘은 쌓였다. 이어 깨울 때마다 알림이 또 오니 더하면 겹쳐 센다 — 마지막 알림
  하나만 쓴다
- 못 잼: subagent_tokens 의 정확한 정의(과금 합인지 맥락 크기인지). `tokens=` 의 뜻이 어느 쪽인지는
  사람의 결정이 필요하다

7. 모델 이름
- 사실: 서브에이전트는 시스템 프롬프트에서 제 이름을 안다 — 이 일꾼 "Opus 5.5 / claude-opus-5-5",
  프로브 "Sonnet 5.5 / claude-sonnet-5-5". 일꾼 보고의 `Model ran:` 줄이 실제 이름을 댈 수 있다
  (`model:` 줄의 모델 칸은 `opus-5.5`·`sonnet-5.5` 꼴 — 본문 예의 `sonnet-5` 가 아니다)

8. effort
- 사실: `Agent(effort:"low")` 가 오류 없이 받아들여졌다. 서브에이전트 안에서도 그 인자가 선다
- 못 잼: effort 가 실제로 걸렸는지(기록에 드러나는 자리가 없다)

fxp 결과: (1) `Agent` 에 이름 인자가 없다 — 끝난 일꾼을 깨우는 주소는 spawn 결과의 agentId 다(`SendMessage(to: <agentId>)` 로 같은 기록에서 잇는 것은 확인). (2) 보고 본문은 `<agent-message from=<agentId>>` 로 따로 오고, 알림의 `<usage>` 에는 수치만 선다. (3) `subagent_tokens` 는 중첩 자식(리뷰 서브에이전트·code-review 포크)을 안 세고, 쌓인 합이 아니라 마지막 맥락 크기에 가깝다 — 이어 깨울 때마다 알림이 또 오니 마지막 알림 하나만 쓴다. 감독이 적는 `tokens=` 에 리뷰 몫은 없다. 자세히는 moai-9tqo.fxp 노트 4~6

fxp 결과: (1) 서브에이전트에서 `EnterWorktree(path)` 는 거절된다(루트에 선 에이전트는 못 옮긴다) — 절대 경로 길이 유일하다, 전제 성립. (2) `Skill(code-review, "<grade> --fix <워크트리 절대 경로>")` 는 그 자리에서 돌지 않고 부른 쪽 모델의 **백그라운드 포크**로 뜬다 — REVIEW_BRIEF 는 리뷰 서브에이전트가 포크의 끝난 알림을 받은 뒤 트리를 읽고 handback 하게 적어야 한다. 경로 대상을 주면 그 워크트리를 리뷰하고 `--fix` 는 커밋 없이 작업 트리에 남긴다(확인). (3) 리뷰 서브에이전트의 토큰은 일꾼 알림에 안 실리지만, 일꾼이 리뷰 서브에이전트의 부모라 그 끝난 알림의 `<usage><subagent_tokens>` 를 직접 받는다 — 리뷰 이슈의 `model:` 줄에 tokens 를 적을 수 있다(본문의 "토큰은 모르니 뺀다" 는 틀렸다). (4) 모델 실명은 시스템 프롬프트에 선다(`claude-sonnet-5-5` → `sonnet-5.5`) — `Model ran:` 은 별칭 대신 실명을 댈 수 있다. 자세히는 moai-9tqo.fxp 노트
model: anthropic/opus-5.5 (high — 서브에이전트 일꾼 실기 조사, sonnet 중첩 프로브 하나 포함)

사람의 결정 (2026-10-12, fxp 결과에 대한 답)

1. tokens 는 측정에서 아예 뺀다 — `model:` 줄에 `tokens=` 를 적지 않는다. 까닭: 서브에이전트 끝난 알림의 subagent_tokens 는 과금 합이 아니라 마지막 맥락 크기에 가깝고 중첩 리뷰 몫이 빠진다(fxp 노트) — 정확하지 않은 값이다
   - 이 에픽에서 고칠 글: rsl(감독이 model: 줄 적기 — 토큰 없이), p1p(리뷰 이슈 줄), zk3(CLAUDE.md "일한 AI 를 남긴다" 의 꼴과 tokens 규칙), 그리고 AGENTS 블록·moai 스킬이 가르치는 `tokens=<count>` 꼴. C 의 65h(`openai/… tokens=`)·bjj(`/status` 토큰) 도 같다
   - 파서·stats 의 토큰 합을 걷을지(Removed)는 이 에픽에서 정한다 — 옛 줄은 읽기는 관대하게
   - moai-rs3o 에 적힌 `tokens=216754` 는 이 결정 전의 값이고 정확하지 않다
2. moai 훅을 이 저장소에 깔았다(skill install, local). fxp 의 "확인 못 함"(규칙 1·3 의 서브에이전트 판정, 감독 Stop 이 실제로 붙드는가)은 훅이 깔린 세션에서 다시 잰다 — fxp 를 다시 연다
tokens 를 적지 않는다(사람의 결정 2026-10-12, moai-9tqo 노트) — 65h 의 `openai/… tokens=` 와 bjj 의 `/status` 토큰 항목은 걷는다

note: 훅이 깔린 세션에서 다시 잰다(사람 2026-10-12)

text:
Next: 다시 잴 것 — 반드시 skill install(2026-10-12) **뒤에 시작한 세션**에서. 그 전에 연 세션은 플러그인 훅을 안 싣는다: 2026-10-12 설치 직후 같은 세션에서 A 멤버를 쥔 채 `moai add '훅 탐침' --dry-run` 을 쳤더니 훅이 막지 않고 바이너리의 오류만 나왔다
- 첫 걸음: 세션이 훅을 싣는지 해 없는 탐침으로 확인(무언가 쥔 채 `moai add` 가 규칙 1 에 막히는가)
- 규칙 1: 서브에이전트가 감독이 쥔 것과 다른 에픽에 `moai add` 를 치면 막히는가(훅은 agent_id 를 몰라 감독의 초점으로 잴 것 — 그대로 맞는지)
- 규칙 3: 서브에이전트가 리뷰 이슈 없이 `Skill(code-review, …)` 를 부르면 막히는가 — 실제 리뷰가 돌지 않게 싼 대상으로
- Stop: 감독 세션이 쥔 채 턴을 끝내면 닫기 물음이 붙드는가, 서브에이전트의 끝(SubagentStop 은 안 심었다)에서는 무엇이 서는가
- 실험은 scratchpad 의 임시 저장소(`moai init`)를 `moai -C` 로 겨눠 진짜 트래커를 더럽히지 않는다
- model: 줄에 tokens= 를 적지 않는다(moai-9tqo 노트)

title: review — A 에픽 끝 (사용후기 어긋남 셋)

text:
2026-10-12 새 세션의 탐침 — 앞 노트의 "설치 전에 연 세션이라 훅이 안 실렸다" 는 추정은 **틀렸을 수 있다**
- 사실: 이 세션(설치 뒤에 시작)은 UserPromptSubmit 훅의 보드가 실렸다 — 플러그인 훅은 서 있다
- 사실: A 멤버 넷이 in_progress(담당 Raven)인 채로 `moai add '훅 탐침'` 을 PreToolUse 에 손으로 먹여도(`moai hook pre-tool-use`, 합성 JSON) 종료 0, 출력 없음 — 규칙 1 이 막지 않는다

재는 자리: moai 0.15.1(~/.local/bin), 플러그인 local 설치. 실험은 scratchpad 의 `git init`+`moai init` 저장소(lab)를 `moai -C <글자 그대로의 경로>` 로 겨눴다. "재연" 은 `moai hook <이벤트>` 에 합성 JSON 을 먹인 것 — 바이너리의 판정이지 하네스를 지난 것은 아니다.

1. 훅이 실렸는가
- 사실: 이 세션(설치 뒤 시작)에 PreToolUse·Stop 이 선다 — 루트의 `mv` 가 이 세션 id 로 집기 기록(`~/.config/moai/picks/<트래커 키>/<session_id>`)에 적혔고, 턴 끝을 Stop 이 붙들었고, lab 에서 규칙 1 이 막았다
- 사실: Codex 탭 둘(3la·uzhx.bjj)의 집기도 제 세션 id 로 같은 자리에 적혀 있다 — Codex 훅도 선다
- 사실: 서브에이전트의 Bash·Skill 부름에도 PreToolUse 가 선다(거절문이 서브에이전트에게 돌아갔다)
- 사실: 서브에이전트가 집은 줄(lab-eluk.26j)이 **부모 세션 id** 로 적혔다. 훅에게 서브에이전트는 부모 세션과 같은 세션이다(`Input` 은 agent_id 를 안 읽는다). 서브에이전트의 `pwd` 는 루트 — 훅의 cwd 도 세션 자리(루트)다

2. 규칙 1
- 사실: 워크트리 전 — 부모가 lab 에서 집은 줄 둘을 쥔 채 서브에이전트의 맨 `moai add` 가 막혔다(그 둘을 댔다). 서브에이전트가 다른 에픽의 줄을 집은 뒤 맨 add 는 셋을 대며 막혔다. 감독과 서브에이전트 일꾼은 초점 하나를 나눠 쓴다
- 사실: 워크트리 뒤 — lab 에 `.worktrees/lab-hadj`(가지 `worktree-lab-hadj`)를 세우자 lab-hadj 멤버 둘을 쥔 채 맨 add 가 지나갔다(lab-6kgm 이 섰다). 루트에 선 세션에게 그 에픽은 옆 워크트리의 일이다. 서브에이전트 일꾼은 EnterWorktree 를 못 쓰니(앞 노트) 늘 루트에 선다 → **제 워크트리를 세운 뒤로는 규칙 1 이 그 일꾼에게 안 선다**
- 사실: 루트에서 친 첫 탐침(fxp 를 쥔 채 `moai add '훅 탐침' --dry-run`)이 지나간 까닭은 Codex 가 3la 로 세운 `.worktrees/moai-9tqo` 다 — 에픽 이름이라 에픽 전체(fxp 포함)를 옆의 일로 가리킨다. 감독의 02:20 탐침(A 멤버를 쥔 채)도 `.worktrees/moai-rs3o` 이름이 같은 일을 했을 것이다 — 그 노트가 댄 `Away::unsure` 는 겹쳐 본 뒤에야 서는 두 번째 자다. 워크트리 없이 에픽의 멤버 하나를 맡은 일꾼(이 fxp 처럼)도, 옆이 그 에픽 이름의 워크트리를 세우는 순간 루트에서 초점을 잃는다
- 사실: `-C "$L"` 처럼 변수로 적은 경로는 훅이 모르는 자리로 보고(`unknowable`) 세션 자리의 트래커로 판정하고 집기도 거기 적는다(lab id 가 루트의 기록에 적혔다). 글이 `-C <root>` 를 글자 그대로 적게 해야 하는 까닭이다

3. 규칙 3
- 사실: 서브에이전트가 리뷰 이슈 없이 부른 `Skill(code-review, "low <lab>/tiny.rs")` 가 막혔다(PreToolUse:Skill, "You are holding nothing") — 리뷰는 안 돌았다. `Skill` 에는 `-C` 가 없어 **판정은 늘 세션 자리(루트)의 트래커다** — 인자의 경로가 남의 저장소여도 그렇다. 그 순간 이 세션의 루트 초점은 비어 있었다(fxp 는 `.worktrees/moai-9tqo`, A 멤버는 `.worktrees/moai-rs3o` 이름에 걸렸다)
- 사실(재연): lab 에 관점이 적힌 리뷰 이슈(`--parent lab-hadj`)를 세워 집은 뒤에도, cwd 가 lab 루트면 같은 Skill 이 "You are holding nothing" 으로 막힌다 — 리뷰 줄도 워크트리 이름 `lab-hadj` 에 걸려 옆의 것이 된다. cwd 가 그 워크트리 안이면 지나간다
- → **루트에 선 서브에이전트 일꾼(과 그 중첩 리뷰 서브에이전트)은 규약대로 리뷰 이슈를 세워 집어도 규칙 3 에 막힌다.** 에픽 설계의 "리뷰는 일꾼의 중첩 서브에이전트로" 가 이 훅 아래서는 서지 않는다 — 사람의 결정이 필요하다(훅이 agent_id 로 서브에이전트를 가르게 하거나, 리뷰를 워크트리 안에 선 세션이 돌리거나, 다른 길)

4. Stop
- 사실: 본 세션의 턴 끝을 실제로 붙들었다 — "Warnings grew from 4 to 8"(`wip_overload` 의 id 가 이 세션이 시작한 뒤 집힌 넷만큼 늘었다). 쥔 일(fxp)은 대지 않았다 — `.worktrees/moai-9tqo` 이름에 걸려 옆의 것. 세션에 한 번(`.stop` 표식)
- 사실: 서브에이전트는 끝에서 훅의 말을 못 봤다. 사용자 범위 memory-layer `Stop` 훅이 본 세션의 턴 끝(17:29:38Z)은 적었고 서브에이전트의 끝은 안 적었다 → 서브에이전트의 끝에는 `Stop` 이 안 선다(그 자리는 SubagentStop 이고 moai 는 안 심는다)
- 사실(재연): 워크트리 전 lab 상태에서 감독(이 세션 id, cwd=lab)의 Stop 은 서브에이전트가 집은 lab-eluk.26j 까지 제 쥔 일로 대며 붙든다. 워크트리 뒤 cwd=lab 루트면 lab-hadj 멤버를 안 붙든다(통과), cwd=그 워크트리면 붙든다
- → 감독의 Stop 은 서브에이전트 일꾼이 집기와 워크트리 사이에 있을 때 그 줄을 붙든다(세션에 한 번만). 워크트리가 선 뒤에는 아무도 그 에픽을 안 붙든다 — 서브에이전트 일꾼이 쥔 채 끝나도 닫기 물음이 서는 자리가 없다

못 잼
- 서브에이전트의 끝에서 moai 의 Stop 이 불리는지를 moai 쪽 표식으로는 못 갈랐다 — 이 세션의 한 번을 그 전에 본 세션의 턴 끝이 이미 썼다. 위 결론은 memory-layer 흔적에 기댄 간접 증거다
- 훅 입력에 agent_id 가 실제로 오는지 — moai 가 그 칸을 안 읽고, 원문을 남길 훅을 더하지 않았다(설정을 안 고쳤다)
- 워크트리 뒤의 규칙 3 은 재연으로만 쟀다 — 실제 서브에이전트의 Skill 부름은 lab 을 겨눌 수 없다(판정이 세션 자리로 간다)
- 규칙 2(서브에이전트의 Edit)는 이번 목록 밖이라 안 쟀다
- 서브에이전트를 띄우기 전에 사람에게 묻지 않았다 — 방법의 "묻는다" 는 보이는 시험 탭의 선례였고, 이것은 스크래치만 만지는 세션 안 서브에이전트다

Review of `milestone/moai-fmge...HEAD` (4 commits: moai-rs3o.j6v, .nmu, .fg4, .tpk). I found 8 issues, fixed 4 in the working tree and skipped 4. The fixes are not committed. `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets` are clean, and `cargo test` passes (1998 unit, 785 cli). I checked that both new test cases fail on the old code.

1. src/report.rs:5571 — The wip_overload bundle key is worked out per line, not per id, so two lines with the same id (same kind) that name different epics count as two bundles for one id. The comment says twins still count once, which is wrong.
   Failure: Two lines both `argos-0300` (Issue, in_progress), one with epic e001 and one with e002, plus two issues with no epic: 4 bundles > limit 3. The warning says 4 but `ids` lists 3 ids. The id-counting rule from moai-ddtg is broken, and the Stop hook's warning sum goes up.
2. src/report.rs:5576 — `fold_top` is given `soil.lines.rooted`, so under a top-level backlog item it returns None and each `--parent` child falls back to its own id. This breaks the CHANGELOG rule that a row with no epic is one bundle with the rows below it.
   Failure: Backlog `argos-0400` with children `.a` and `.b` in progress, plus two more issues with no epic: 4 bundles instead of 3, so wip_overload fires (the tree draws both children under the backlog item).
3. src/cmd/backlog.rs:101 — Breaks CLAUDE.md: "`cmd/*.rs` 안에 이슈의 뜻을 판단하는 `if` 를 두지 않는다." `say_if_inherited` decides in cmd/ whether the carried milestone was inherited (`if thought.milestone.as_deref() == Some(m)` plus the Handing lookup).
   Failure: The meaning of the issue is judged outside report, so other surfaces such as the TUI cannot reuse it and it can drift from report's rules.
4. src/cli.rs:151 — The `status_wip_limit` help line (copied into docs/cli.md) and the `Thresholds::wip_limit` doc in config.rs still say the limit counts rows opened at once. It now counts bundles.
   Failure: Someone setting `status_wip_limit = 3` from `moai status --help` expects 4 started rows to warn, but 4 members of one epic stay silent.
5. src/view.rs:882 — The board line uses `count` (now the bundle count) but lists every row id under it, and the text does not say what is counted.
   Failure: The board shows "Started at once 4" (ko: "벌여 놓은 것 4건") followed by six ids; a reader sees the number and the list disagree.
6. src/cmd/backlog.rs:309 — On the real path the 'inherited' stderr line is printed inside the write closure before `create_drafts` checks the plan, so a promote that then fails has already said the epic stands in that release.
   Failure: Promote with an invalid plan line: stderr says the unfolded epic stands in milestone M, then the command fails and nothing was unfolded.
7. src/cmd/backlog.rs:104 — A milestone inherited from a parent issue (no epic on the path) is still carried silently, even though it surprises the person the same way (empty field, unfolded epic lands in a release).
   Failure: Backlog item `P.x` under issue P with milestone M and no epic: promote puts the new epic in M and prints no line.
8. src/cmd/backlog.rs:104 — `Handing::of(issues)` builds `Lines` and `Handing` over every row again, inside the write lock, right after `stone_of` already built them through `report::milestones`.
   Failure: Extra O(n log n) work while the tracker lock is held during promote.

Fixed:
- 1 and 2 (src/report.rs): the bundle key is now stored once per id, and the later line wins, the same rule as `by_id`. `fold_top` is called with an empty rooted set, so it climbs to the top of the id chain. I updated the comment and added both cases to `members_of_one_epic_count_as_one_bundle`.
- 3: the check now lives in a new pure function, `report::inherited_from(all, i, stone)`. `say_if_inherited` in src/cmd/backlog.rs just calls it.
- 4: the help line in src/cli.rs:151 and docs/cli.md:151 now reads "more than this opened at once, an epic as one" (79 columns), and the doc in src/config.rs says the same. `the_cli_reference_matches_the_help` passes.

Skipped:
- 5: the CHANGELOG says `count` = bundles and `ids` = rows on purpose, and the README sample uses the current wording. Changing the text is your call.
- 6: `say_if_dead` already prints at that same point, and the doc comments promise the dry run and the real run print the same lines in the same order. Moving it would break that.
- 7: the doc comment and CHANGELOG limit the line to milestones inherited from an epic, so this is the intended scope.
- 8: promote is a one-off command, and the extra build only happens when the line fires. Removing it would mean changing `stone_of`, which this change didn't touch.
